sentences.text:
Ms. Archana Maheshwari, counsel for the appellant No.1.
 Mr. H.S.Rathore, counsel for the respondent/State.

Heard on IA No.19927/2024 which is third application under Section 430 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, for suspension of remaining jail sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of appellant No.1 - Mohit S/o Shri Bherusingh Sondhiya.

The appellant No.1 - Mohit has been convicted for commission of offence punishable under Sections 366 and 376-D of Indian Penal Code, 1860 and sentenced to undergo Rigorous Imprisonment of seven years and twenty years with fine of Rs.1000/- and Rs.5000/- respectively with further default stipulation.
Counsel for the appellant No.1 submits that appellant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the aforesaid crime.
He further submits that prosecutrix has eloped with appellant No.1 on her own accord and she lived with the appellant No.1 for almost one month.
Thereafter the prosecutrix was recovered and she was being medically examined and found that she was below eighteen years of age.
In her cross-examination, she has stated that appellant has not forced her to live with him.
The appellant No.1 is in jail since last five years and he is 21 years of age.
The appellant No.1 has no criminal past record.
This appeal is of the year 2019 and the final conclusion 2 CRA-4719-2019 of this appeal would take long time to conclude.
Hence the remaining jail sentence of the appellant No.1 may be suspended.
Per contra, counsel for the respondent/State opposes the application and prays for its rejection.

Taking into consideration the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case so also the fact that the appellant No.1 has no criminal past and was in jail for the last five years, we deem it proper to suspend the remaining jail sentence and grant the benefit of suspension to appellant No.1.
Accordingly, IA No.19927/2024 stands allowed.

sentences.text:
The execution of remaining jail sentence of appellant No.1 - appellant No.1 - Mohit S/o Shri Bherusingh Sondhiya is hereby suspended and it is ordered that the appellant No.1 be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees Fifty Thousand only)
with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of trial court and subject to depositing of the fine amount (if not already deposited) with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 09.05.2025 and also on such further dates as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard during the pendency of the appeal.
This appeal has already been admitted on 06.06.2019 .
List the appeal for final hearing in due course.
Certified copy, as per Rules.

(VIVEK RUSIA) (PRANA  JUDGE J  3 CRA-4719-2019  Arun/-
